item.title: Nitazenes now detected in 12 European monitoring systems
item.description: EMCDDA early-warning reports show the nitazene family (etonitazene, metonitazene, isotodesnitazene) spreading from the Baltics across Western Europe, mostly hidden in counterfeit oxycodone and 'heroin'.

item.title: Xylazine ('Tranq') confirmed in drug supply outside North America
item.description: First confirmed lab detections of xylazine-adulterated fentanyl in the UK and EU supply. Wound-care and naloxone-limit guidance is being updated by harm-reduction services.

item.title: High-dose ecstasy pills (250–330 mg) circulating again this festival season
item.description: Pill-testing services across Europe are flagging pressed pills at 2–3x a typical adult dose. PMA/PMMA copycat pills — slow to kick in, deadly — remain in circulation.

item.title: Counterfeit 'Xanax bars' increasingly contain flubromazolam or fentanyl
item.description: Forensic testing in the US and UK shows counterfeit alprazolam bars frequently contain the ultra-potent RC benzo flubromazolam — active at 0.25 mg — and intermittent fentanyl.
